<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 78:15">Targ. Ps. LXXVIII, 15</cite> <he>רבנהון</he> Ms. (ed. <he>רבהון</he>); a. e.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:3:36">Y. Ter. VIII, 46ᵃ</cite> <he>זמון חד ר׳ וכ׳</he> invited a certain teacher and placed a dog beside him.
Y. B. Mets. II, end, 8ᵈ חד ר׳ דמך וכ׳ a certain scholar is dead, and all the people are running &c.; a. e.—Esp. Rabbana, a Babylonian title.
<cite ref="Yevamot 22a:1">Yeb. 22ᵃ</cite> <he>מר בריה דר׳</he> Mar, the son of R. (Ashshi).
Pes. 115ᵇ ר׳ עוקבא; a. e.; [perh. = רַבֵּנוּ our teacher].—Pl. רַבָּנִין, רַבָּנָן.
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 68:28">Targ. Ps. LXVIII, 28</cite> (h. text <cite ref="U01959"><he>שרי</he></cite>); a. e.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 8:3:12">Y. Ter. VIII, 45ᶜ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Maasrot 5:3:7">Y. Maasr. V, 52ᵃ</cite> top, a. e. <he>חברון דר׳</he>, v. <he>הֲנַנְיָא</he>.
Succ. 8ᵃ; Erub. 76ᵇ ר׳ דקיסרי the scholars of Cæsaræa; a. fr.—Esp. (corresp. to חכמים of the Mishnah, v. חָכָם) a number of scholars, as opposed to a single authority.
Ber. 5ᵇ; a. v. fr.—דְּרַ׳, מִדְּרַ׳ rabbinical enactment, rabbinically ordained, opp. דאוריתא, מדאורייתא, v. אוֹרָיָיא.
<cite ref="Sukkah 44a">Succ. 44ᵃ</cite>. Pes. l. c.; a. v. fr.—[<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 1:11">Midr. Till. to Ps. I</cite> <he>כשני רבנן</he>, v. <cite ref="K00099"><he>כַּד</he> II</cite>.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:7:14">Y. Kidd. I, 61ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>דרבנין</he>, v. <cite ref="T00305"><he>רוּבָּה</he> II</cite>.]
